description: This file contains the implementation of DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter, a class that extends DittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter and manages logging with MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries, correlation IDs, and integration with Akka's DiagnosticLoggingAdapter. It employs the state pattern for handling logger states and MDC entries.

classes.name: DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter
classes.description: A final class implementing a logging adapter that manages MDC entries, correlation IDs, and logger states, integrating with Akka's DiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter with provided DiagnosticLoggingAdapter and logger name.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID in the MDC, resetting the logger state to autoDiscardingLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: withCorrelationId (overloaded)
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID from WithDittoHeaders or DittoHeaders objects.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID in the MDC.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from MDC.

methods.name: setMdcEntry
methods.description: Sets a single MDC entry and resets logger state.

methods.name: setMdcEntries
methods.description: Sets multiple MDC entries and resets logger state.

methods.name: discardMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes a specific MDC entry.

methods.name: setMdcEntry (overloaded)
methods.description: Sets MDC entries from MdcEntry objects or sequences.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates an MDC entry in the current logger state.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds an MDC entry to autoDiscardingLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries to autoDiscardingLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry from the current logger.

methods.name: discardMdcEntries
methods.description: Clears all MDC entries from the current logger.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current logger.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isWarningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug level logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error message or throwable.

methods.name: notifyWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message.

methods.name: notifyInfo
methods.description: Logs an info message.

methods.name: notifyDebug
methods.description: Logs a debug message.

methods.name: mdc
methods.description: Returns the current MDC as an immutable map.

methods.name: mdc (setter)
methods.description: Sets the MDC for the current logger.

methods.name: getMDC
methods.description: Returns the current MDC as a Map.

methods.name: setMDC
methods.description: Sets the MDC from a Map.

methods.name: clearMDC
methods.description: Clears all MDC entries.
